prompt:
Estimate the probability that one valid test in each unit exposes a defect.
A unit is a five-part name engine|oracle|construct|plan class|data class.
engine is the database engine under test.
oracle is the testing oracle that judges the statement.
construct is the SQL construct (the third field).
plan class is the query-plan class (the fourth field).
data class is the data shape (the fifth field).
A typical unit fails about 1 time in 100 valid tests (the reference rate).
Units to price, one per line:
UNIT datafusion|cross_dbms|set_op_all|join|dups
UNIT datafusion|cross_dbms|set_op_all|join|nulls
Evidence lines from engine source history (changelog or issue tests):
EVIDENCE datafusion dev/changelog/10.0.0.md:54 - Improve UX for `UNION` vs `UNION ALL` \(introduce a LogicalPlan::Distinct\) [\#2573](https://github.com/apache/datafusion/issues/2573) [[sql](https://github.com/apache/datafusion/labels/sql)]
EVIDENCE datafusion dev/changelog/12.0.0.md:108 - FilterPushDown optimization through UNION ALL results in SchemaError [\#3281](https://github.com/apache/datafusion/issues/3281)
EVIDENCE datafusion dev/changelog/12.0.0.md:204 - Fix SchemaError in FilterPushDown optimization with UNION ALL [\#3282](https://github.com/apache/datafusion/pull/3282) ([jonmmease](https://github.com/jonmmease))
EVIDENCE datafusion dev/changelog/25.0.0.md:114 - Fix UNION ALL aliasing [#6373](https://github.com/apache/datafusion/pull/6373) (comphead)
Reply with one JSON object and no other text.
prediction is a list of objects, one object per unit you price.
unit is the unit string copied from a UNIT line.
p_fail is a number in [0.0, 1.0], not a boolean.
why is a short English reason.
JSON shape:
{"prediction": [{"unit": "engine|oracle|construct|plan|data", "p_fail": 0.0, "why": "reason"}]}
text: {"prediction":[{"unit":"datafusion|cross_dbms|set_op_all|join|dups","p_fail":0.08,"why":"UNION ALL/set_op_all has repeated DataFusion changelog issues around schema errors, filter pushdown, and aliasing; join plus duplicate data raises risk above the 1% baseline."},{"unit":"datafusion|cross_dbms|set_op_all|join|nulls","p_fail":0.1,"why":"UNION ALL is historically defect-prone in DataFusion, and NULLs add join/set-op semantic edge cases, making failure somewhat more likely than baseline."}]}
